bodies.en: We have released a new patch addressing various issues and some changes. The Action Point gain from the Kraken Boss has been increased by 50%. An issue related to entering the Combat Zone as a party has been fixed. An issue related to entering Dungeons through the Party Finder has been fixed. The issue with point distribution in the Combat Zone has been fixed. An issue affecting the scores of some clans that exceeded 2 billion points in the clan rankings has been fixed. For now, the score is capped at 2 billion, but this limit will be removed soon. Clan members may continue their activities to earn higher scores; once the limit is removed, the actual scores above 2 billion will be displayed correctly. This issue is currently caused by The Quinfall running with two separate clients.

bodies.en: Gameplay & Reward Update Hey everyone, With this update, we’re making several changes aimed at improving activity across PvP and PvE content, while also making key gameplay loops feel more rewarding. Combat Zone Combat Zone is now active on all channels . Please note that this may not be fully reflected in the UI yet, but the system is active and players can participate in all channels. Arena We’re reducing the Arena schedule from 1 hour to 30 minutes . Our goal here is to make Arena more accessible throughout the day and reduce the downtime between matches. Arena Rewards Arena rewards have been improved. Players will now receive 3 Tera Pieces per win . Open World Boss Rewards All Open World Bosses now grant 75,000 Action Coins . This includes Vorgath as well. Kraken remains at 30,000 Action Coins for now. Dungeon Rewards Dungeon Action Point gains have been increased by 5x . We want dungeons to feel more worthwhile as a repeatable PvE activity, and this change is a step toward making that progression path more rewarding. 3v3 Arena Rewards We’re increasing 3v3 Arena rewards to make competitive progression feel more rewarding across every league. Winners will now receive Tera Piece…

bodies.en: Greetings Adventurers, We are rolling out a new update to improve your gameplay experience. This patch addresses several bugs reported by the community, some changes and includes general stability improvements. Here are the patch notes for version 1.0.0.32: Fixed various translation issues. The Character Level 100 Coupon, Selected Weapon Level 100 Coupon, Weapon Type Changer, and Armor Type Changer have been permanently added to the store. This change is done in response to community feedback and requests for improved progression and greater customization options. Additionally, as the core content and gameplay experience largely begin after reaching Level 100, this change is intended to help players access that stage of the game more easily. Resolved several user interface-related bugs. Added preliminary modules for the upcoming major Optimization and Lighting Update. Performed additional server-side optimization improvements.

bodies.en: Our new hotfix patch is now live. We have fixed various bugs and issues to make your Quinfall experience smoother. You can find the details of this update below. Character Experience Developer Note: We’ve heard your feedback and reviewed the current leveling pace across all stages of progression. The journey to higher levels has been taking longer than intended, especially for players trying to catch up or experience more of the game’s core content. The EXP requirement for characters has been halved for all levels. HP Regen and MP Regen Developer Note: After reviewing combat performance and player data, we found that HP Regen and MP Regen Power Stones were providing significantly more sustain than intended. To bring these Power Stones closer to their intended balance, their effects have been reduced by 50%. Our goal with this change is to keep regeneration valuable, while preventing it from creating situations where sustain becomes too difficult to overcome. The effects of HP Regen and MP Regen Power Stones have been halved.

bodies.en: Our new hotfix patch is now live. We have fixed various bugs and issues to make your Quinfall experience smoother. You can find the details of this update below. Weapon & Combat Balance Weapon Critical Multipliers Developer Note: After reviewing their performance, we feel they are currently a bit too strong compared to the rest of the weapon pool. This change is aimed at bringing them back into a healthier balance range without removing their identity or impact in combat. Dagger base critical multiplier adjusted to 1.33 . Crossbow base critical multiplier adjusted to 1.33 . Bow base critical multiplier adjusted to 1.28 . Life Staff Developer Note: This adjustment is intended to improve sustain and overall usability, especially in longer engagements, without pushing the weapon outside of its intended support-focused role. Life Staff mana value increased by 15% . Frenzy Skill Update Developer Note: This update is designed to reduce the defensive trade-off pressure on players while maintaining the skill's strong offensive identity in combat. bodies.en: Greetings Adventurers, Patch 1.0.0.29 is focused on building a stronger foundation for future balance and design work. In the previous patch, many systems scaled in a way that made tuning extremely difficult. Because several values grew exponentially or relied too heavily on flat bonuses, small balance adjustments could create massive outliers. Changing basic numbers often caused unexpected spikes in damage, defense, healing, or survivability, which made the game harder to balance cleanly. This patch moves several core systems toward percentage-based scaling and clearer class identity. The goal is to make builds easier to understand, easier to adjust, and easier to design around moving forward. Armor weight, attributes, gems, talismans, stamina, and critical damage have all been updated with that goal in mind. Players should have more meaningful build choices, while the design team should have a more stable foundation for future balance passes. Item Converter Developer Note: Many players invest heavily into a gear set, then eventually grow bored of that weapon or class. This game should encourage players to try multiple gear sets. The Item Converter is intended to help players who…

bodies.en: Greetings Adventurers, We are rolling out a new update to improve your gameplay experience. This patch addresses several bugs reported by the community, some changes and includes general stability improvements. Here are the patch notes for version 1.0.0.28: BUG FIXES A collider issue related to some escape points in Trio Arena has been fixed. Unintended escape paths have been removed to ensure fairer engagements. An issue where set bonus items caused stat inconsistencies has been fixed. All gear bonuses now apply correctly and consistently. A rare issue where players were instantly removed from Trio Arena matches has been fixed. This improves overall match stability. Various text and localization issues have been fixed. General wording improvements have been applied. An issue related to clan join date updates has been fixed. Dates are now displayed correctly. bodies.en: Greetings players, We are excited to announce our major update. In this patch we are bringing the highly anticipated 3v3 Arena to The Quinfall. Gather your team, step into the arena and show your skills. Alongside this massive addition we also included important changes and bug fixes to make your adventure even better. New Trio Arena 3v3 The new 3v3 event system, Trio Arena , has been added to the game. This is our fully queue-based competitive arena where you don’t walk in to pay an entry fee or stack advantages—you queue up, get matched, and fight on equal terms. Fair matchmaking, structured teams, and a controlled environment built purely around skill expression. We’re also taking a firm stance against anything that breaks competitive integrity. Win trading and similar behaviors don’t belong here, and we’re actively putting systems and penalties in place to deal with it properly. Performance matters the most—at the end of each weekly cycle, players will be ranked and rewarded based on their standing, with high-value rewards with meaningful loot reserved for those who climb. Inside the arena, things stay clean. No consumables, no scrolls, no outside advantages. Gear is equalized…

bodies.en: Our new hotfix patch is now live. We have fixed various bugs and issues to make your Quinfall experience smoother. You can find the details of this update below. Fixed various spelling and translation errors. Removed Profession EXP bonus from starter EXP boosters. Reduced overall damage dealt to build objects. Purple/Legendary level 100 equipment with low or no star level can now also yield Ancient Ore when dismantled. Fixed visual error between Evasion Power Stones and Accuracy Power Stones. Fixed an issue related to inserting Power Stones into equipment. Ancient Ore drop rate from mobs in the Combat Zone has been increased by 3x. Fixed an issue where mounts could not be used at Combat Zone spawn points. Mount usage is still restricted within the PvP circle.
